sourceBasis.step: Add one private vertex adjacent to both ends of each edge of the Vertex Cover instance. A cover leaves a forest. Conversely, any feedback vertex set hits each edge triangle, so replacing any selected private vertex with an endpoint yields a cover of no larger size. A bag for each private vertex and its endpoints gives treewidth at most max(n−1, 2) for original order n, with polynomial encoding size.
